item.title: Russian body, Desi brain: How India is turning the Su-30MKI into a lethal stealth hunter
item.description: India is developing the Virupaksha radar for its Su-30MKI fleet, potentially giving the Russian-designed fighter much stronger long-range detection capabilities.

item.title: US Air Force wants AI help to keep its Minuteman III nukes ticking until they're 66, or maybe 80
item.description: The US Air Force wants AI to unify Minuteman III data as Sentinel delays could extend missile service toward 80 years.

item.title: Quote of the day by Elon Musk: '[The Tesla Bot] has the potential to be a generalized substitute for human labor over time' — a bold prediction on the future of work
item.description: Although humanoid robots aren't anywhere near ready for real-world deployment, tech execs like Musk are adamant they're coming for our jobs
